#### Notice: This edits literally every single champion `WAD` in the game, so to avoid long loadtime, read the yellow text.

###### *Before* importing this into CSLoL, delete the WAD for each champ you will not play or do not want from the .fantome

#### Overview:

* Applies a greyscale filter to every single Champion QWERp icon.
* Does not do anything special for champs that need greyscale icons for buff tracking, so just don't use it if you need that differentiation for your champ. (ex. Katarina)
